title: "Sexism Power Analysis"
author: "Abby Person"

output: html_document

```{r}



library(lavaan)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducibility


sample_sizes_dyads <- c(500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000)
n_sims             <- 2000   # sims
alpha              <- 0.05  # Salpha

# All estimates from Overall et al. (2025)
# Predictor Scale Parameters (-3 to 3 Scale)
mu_m_scale <-  0.18  # Men's expected mean benevolent sexism
mu_w_scale <- -0.71  # Women's expected mean benevolent sexism
sd_x       <-  1.04  # Estimated standard deviation on a 7-point scale (-3 to 3)

# Population Standardized Effect Sizes
b_act_m  <- -0.15   # Men's Actor effect
b_part_m <- .09   # Women's bs to men's hostile behavior
b_act_w  <-  0.13   # Women's Actor effect
b_part_w <-  -.14   # Men's bs to women's hostile behavior

# Standardized Interaction Effect (Overall et al., 2025)
b_int_m  <- -0.09   # Interaction predicting Men's outcome
b_int_w  <- -0.09   # Interaction predicting Women's outcome

# Correlations
r_x1_x2  <-  0.36   # Correlation between Men's & Women's BS
r_e1_e2  <-  0.30   # Correlation between Men's & Women's Residual Outcomes

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DATA GENERATION FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
generate_dyad_data <- function(N, b_act_m, b_part_m, b_act_w, b_part_w, 
                               b_int_m, b_int_w, r_x1_x2, r_e1_e2,
                               mu_m, mu_w, sd_x) {
  
  # Covariance matrix for raw scale predictors
  sigma_x <- matrix(c(sd_x^2,           r_x1_x2 * sd_x^2, 
                      r_x1_x2 * sd_x^2, sd_x^2), nrow = 2)
  
  # Generate predictors with asymmetrical population means
  X_raw <- mvrnorm(n = N, mu = c(mu_m, mu_w), Sigma = sigma_x)
  
  # Standardize/Center predictors for standardized coefficient estimation
  # Center around respective population means to isolate interaction
  X_m <- (X_raw[, 1] - mu_m) / sd_x
  X_w <- (X_raw[, 2] - mu_w) / sd_x
  
  # Cross-partner Interaction Term
  X_int <- X_m * X_w
  
  # Generate correlated residual errors (Var = 1)
  sigma_e <- matrix(c(1,       r_e1_e2, 
                      r_e1_e2, 1), nrow = 2)
  E <- mvrnorm(n = N, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = sigma_e)
  e_m <- E[, 1]
  e_w <- E[, 2]
  
  # Generate outcomes
  Y_m <- b_act_m * X_m + b_part_m * X_w + b_int_m * X_int + e_m
  Y_w <- b_act_w * X_w + b_part_w * X_m + b_int_w * X_int + e_w
  
  data.frame(
    X_m = X_m, X_w = X_w, 
    X_int = X_int, 
    Y_m = Y_m, Y_w = Y_w
  )
}


apim_model <- '
  # Outcomes predicted by predictors and cross-partner interaction
  Y_m ~ act_m*X_m + part_m*X_w + int_m*X_int
  Y_w ~ act_w*X_w + part_w*X_m + int_w*X_int

  # Correlated Predictors & Residuals
  X_m ~~ X_w
  Y_m ~~ Y_w
'

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SIMULATION LOOP
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
results_list <- list()

cat("Starting Monte Carlo Simulation...\n")

for (N in sample_sizes_dyads) {
  cat(sprintf("Simulating N = %d dyads (%d individuals)...\n", N, N * 2))
  
  p_val_int_m <- numeric(n_sims)
  p_val_int_w <- numeric(n_sims)
  
  for (i in 1:n_sims) {
    df <- generate_dyad_data(N, b_act_m, b_part_m, b_act_w, b_part_w, 
                             b_int_m, b_int_w, r_x1_x2, r_e1_e2,
                             mu_m = mu_m_scale, mu_w = mu_w_scale, sd_x = sd_x)
    
    fit <- sem(apim_model, data = df, warn = FALSE, std.lv = TRUE)
    
    if (lavInspect(fit, "converged")) {
      pvals <- parameterEstimates(fit)
      
      p_val_int_m[i] <- pvals$pvalue[pvals$label == "int_m"]
      p_val_int_w[i] <- pvals$pvalue[pvals$label == "int_w"]
    } else {
      p_val_int_m[i] <- NA
      p_val_int_w[i] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  results_list[[as.character(N)]] <- data.frame(
    N_Dyads = N,
    N_Individuals = N * 2,
    Power_Interaction_Men = mean(p_val_int_m < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    Power_Interaction_Women = mean(p_val_int_w < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

power_results <- bind_rows(results_list)
power_results


```
